title: Hoffman's Pizza Balls (Frozen)
instructions: Arrange the frozen pizza balls in a single layer on a baking sheet.
Bake 12-15 minutes, until golden and the cheese is melted.
Rest 2 minutes before eating — the cheese inside is very hot.
notes: Store-bought frozen staple. 1 serving = about 6 balls. No package information for this product could be found online at all — the directions here are standard bake-from-frozen placeholders. Confirm exact directions from the package; Yidi's package photo is required to finalize this recipe.
